title: SKILL.md frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter block of a SKILL.md file, per the open SKILL.md spec at https://agentskills.io.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case skill identifier. Must not collide with reserved names (see RESERVED_SLUGS).

description.description: Free-form description. Should include a positive trigger ('use when…') and ideally a negative trigger ('do not use when…'). XML tags are forbidden.

skill_type.description: Skill classification per the open spec.

domain_focus.description: Optional focus area within the skill's domain.

tags.description: Optional kebab-case tags. Duplicates are an error (E010).

entities.description: Optional entities (files, libraries, services) the skill operates on.

base_skill.description: Optional parent skill name; for skills that specialise another skill.

token_budget.description: Approximate token cost of loading the skill. Must be a positive integer.

references.description: Optional reference files inside the skill folder.
